readerCopy.headline: The words are working for you.
readerCopy.body:
A proposal is easier to explain. A negotiation stays on the subject. A difficult truth can land without turning into a war. You may find the sentence that makes an idea useful to someone who did not understand it before, or finally know how to ask for the answer you actually need.

Jupiter trine Mercury gives language a little more reach. Use it. Put the work into circulation, make the request, or finish the conversation that has been waiting for cleaner words. Just do not confuse an easy conversation with a finished decision. Put the important part in writing.
